::: {.callout-warning}
## 2026 submission details are forthcoming

The submission form, abstract deadline, eligibility, and abstract requirements
have not yet been posted. Details from the 2025 symposium are retained as a
planning reference and should be reconfirmed for the next meeting.
:::

## Submission information

The 2025 meeting used the registration form for abstract submission. Talk
abstracts had an advance deadline, while poster submissions remained open
until the meeting reached capacity. Current instructions and deadlines will be
added here when they are available.

Once the current program is released, presenters should check the
[Schedule](schedule.qmd) for their assigned time or poster session. Accepted
presenters can find format and preparation guidance on [For Presenters](for-presenters.qmd).
Questions about submissions can be sent through [Contact Us](../contact.qmd).

*[Source: 2025 registration and abstract submission information](https://socalboom.wordpress.com/home/registration-and-abstract-submission/).*
